info.title: OvenLovin API
info.description: The family recipe box your AI can actually use, and it knows who can't eat what. REST for agents. Not medical advice - always check labels.

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: Household API key. Send `ApiKey rkapi_…` or `Bearer rkapi_…`. Create a key under Settings. Bound to one kitchen; a mismatched `X-Kitchen-Id` is rejected.

bearerAuth.description: Same API key as `rkapi_…` (ChatGPT Actions often send Bearer) or a Clerk session JWT. On MCP with a Clerk JWT, optional `X-Kitchen-Id` selects a kitchen you belong to. An API key is bound to one kitchen; a mismatched `X-Kitchen-Id` is rejected.

commitSha.description: VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA for this deploy, or null when not on Vercel.

displayServings.description: Kitchen Default servings, or the `servings` query override. `servings` remains the stored card yield.

previousEntries.description: Nights this PATCH changed, as they were before the edit. Use to revert.

get.summary: Instance configuration and deploy SHA
get.description: Reports integration readiness and the Vercel git commit SHA (`VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA`). Unauthenticated.

get.summary: List recipes
get.description: `images` is a thumbnail URL only. Photo imports never inline `data:` bytes here; fetch `GET /recipes/{id}/image` when Blob is not configured.

schema.description: Comma-separated person IDs. Recipes that hit a block rule for any attendee are omitted from items and listed in hidden with hiddenCount.

parameters.description: Comma-separated person IDs. Recipes that hit a block rule for any attendee are omitted from items and listed in hidden with hiddenCount.
parameters.name: forAttendees

200.description: Recipe page. When forAttendees is set, also returns hiddenCount and hidden.

post.summary: Create a recipe directly (title, ingredients, steps)

get.summary: Get a recipe with ingredients, steps, times, notes, images, and source
get.description: displayServings applies kitchen Default servings (family = max(yield, People count)). Pass ?servings= to override. ingredients.displayText is scaled to displayServings; rawText is the stored import string.

patch.summary: Update recipe metadata, ingredients, steps, images, or cookbook membership

get.summary: Main recipe photo (thumbnail URL from list/search)
get.description: Returns the stored main photo. List and search never inline image bytes: they expose this URL (or a Blob URL) instead of data: URLs. Requires the same household auth as GET /recipes/{id}.

302.description: Redirect to a Blob or remote URL

post.summary: Restore a soft-deleted recipe
Import a recipe from a URL or pasted text
post.description: Preview by default (`save` omitted or false). Persist only when `save=true`. Preview responses include `saved:false` and `preview:true`. Send `Idempotency-Key` so a dropped connection can be retried without a second recipe. URL duplicates and in-flight locks return 409 with `recipeId` / `recipeUrl`. Demo responses include `remainingImports`.

save.description: When true, persist the recipe. Default is preview only.

200.description: Extracted draft for review (save omitted or false), or an idempotent replay

409.description: Duplicate or in-flight import. Includes recipeId, title, and recipeUrl.

503.description: AI recipe reading is busy (import_ai_unavailable). Retry-After is 60 seconds.

post.summary: Import a recipe from HTML or JSON-LD captured on the user's device (Safari shortcut or browser bookmark)

503.description: AI recipe reading is busy (import_ai_unavailable). Retry-After is 60 seconds.

post.summary: Extract a recipe from one or more photos (review by default). Persist only when save=true, same as POST /recipes/import. Exact SHA matches return 409 with the existing recipeId. Near-duplicate PNG photos (perceptual hash of PNG bytes only) are a warning: preview includes possibleDuplicate {recipeId,title}; save:true without allowDuplicate:true returns 409 with the same field. Send allowDuplicate:true to persist anyway. Send Idempotency-Key on save so retries do not create a second recipe.

allowDuplicate.description: When true, persist even if a similar PNG photo already exists.

200.description: Extracted draft for review (save omitted or false)

503.description: AI recipe reading is busy (import_ai_unavailable). Retry-After is 60 seconds.

patch.description: `entries` default to **merge** by date+meal: send one night to set, swap, or `{ clear: true }` to remove it. Other nights are left alone. Pass `entriesMode: replace` to rewrite the whole week. The response includes `previousEntries` for the nights this request changed.

entriesMode.description: How `entries` are applied. Default `merge` upserts by date+meal (use clear:true to remove a night). `replace` rewrites the whole week.

post.summary: Undo the last entries edit
post.description: Restores the previous week snapshot recorded on merge/replace PATCH. Returns the plan plus previousEntries (the state that was undone).

get.summary: List recent meal-plan entry snapshots (newest first)
Check a meal plan against per-person rules and schedule time budgets. Not medical advice.
